name: Tute corriente
description: Tute corriente is the oldest two-player form of Tute from Spain. Six cards each, 13th face up for trump, rest as stock. No follow suit until stock is empty; then must follow and beat or trump. First to 101 points or tute (four kings or horses) wins.

overview.description: Tute corriente is the oldest two-player form of Tute from Spain. Six cards each, 13th face up for trump, rest as stock. No follow suit until stock is empty; then must follow and beat or trump. First to 101 points or tute (four kings or horses) wins.

history.origins: Tute corriente is the oldest two-player form of Tute. Tute originated in Italy as tutti, spread to Spain in the 19th century with returning troops, and became one of Spain's most popular card games; the two-player corriente form is the traditional variant described in Spanish card-game literature.
timeline: 19th century: Tute spread to Spain; two-player form (tute corriente) became established.

setup.players: Two players, each playing for themselves; no partnerships.
setup.dealing: Six cards each; 13th card face up for trump; rest form stock.

rules.objective: Be first to reach 101 or more points from tricks, singing (20/40), and last trick (10); or declare tute (four kings or four horses) after winning a trick to win immediately.
rules.gameplay: Non-dealer leads. Until stock is exhausted: no follow suit or trump required; second player may play any card. Winner of trick draws from stock first, then opponent; face-up trump is last card drawn. After stock empty: must follow suit and beat if possible, trump if cannot follow. After winning a trick, may sing one 40 or 20; tute wins the game. Trump 7 or 2 may be exchanged for turned card before play. Wrong claim of 101+ loses.
keyRules: Relaxed play until stock empty, then follow suit
Draw from stock after each trick

scoring.description: Points from tricks, singing (20/40), and last trick (10). First to 101+ or tute declaration wins.
